tools.name: listAdventures
tools.description: Returns Cub Scout adventures, one item per requirements version. An adventure with several versions appears once per version, sharing `id` but with different `versionId`. Pass an adventure's `id` to the requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing returns an empty list. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

status.description: `active` (the default) leaves out retired adventures, those with an `expiryDt`, and `all` includes them. Case-sensitive.

id.description: Return only versions of the adventure with this `id`

rankId.description: Return only adventures for this rank

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year

versionId.description: Return only the requirements version with this `versionId`

required.description: `true` returns only required adventures, and `false` only elective ones

tools.name: getAdventureRequirements
tools.description: Returns one requirements version of an adventure: the newest by default, or the one given by `versionId`. Retired adventures work too. Requirements are a flat list; nest them using `parentRequirementId` and order them by `sortOrder`.

versionId.description: A `versionId` of this adventure from the adventure list. Defaults to the newest version.

tools.name: listAwards
tools.description: Returns awards, such as knots, palms, and outdoor awards. Pass an award's `id` to the requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Filters combine with AND. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

status.description: `active` (the default) returns awards without an `expiredDate`, `expired` returns those with one, and `all` returns both. Case-sensitive.

programId.description: Return only awards whose `unitTypeId` is this value. Awards for all programs (empty `unitTypeId`) are left out.

tools.name: getAward
tools.description: Returns one award from the award list, with a few fields that differ from the list: `priceLastUpdated` replaces `priceLastupdated`, `program` is absent, `image` is a bare file name, and empty values are often `null`. An ID that isn't in the award list returns `200` with `name` and most other fields `null`, not `404`.

tools.name: getAwardRequirements
tools.description: Returns one requirements version of an award: the newest by default, or the one given by `versionId`. Requirements are a flat list; nest them using `parentRequirementId` and order them by `sortOrder`. Many awards have no requirements. Some IDs that aren't in the award list also return `200`, with an empty version and no requirements.

versionId.description: An `awardVersionId` of this award from its `versions`. Defaults to the newest version. When given, the response has numbers and booleans in place of numeric and `True`/`False` strings (see `AwardVersionRequirements`).

tools.name: listMeritBadges
tools.description: Returns merit badges. Pass a badge's `id` to the requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing returns an empty list.

id.description: Return only the merit badge with this `id`

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year. Badges with no matching version are left out.

status.description: Which requirements versions to put in `versions`. `active` (the default) gives each badge's current version and leaves out discontinued badges. `inactive` gives past versions, including those of discontinued badges, and leaves out badges with none. Case-sensitive.

tools.name: getMeritBadgeRequirements
tools.description: Returns the current requirements version for a merit badge. Requirements are a flat list; nest them using `parentRequirementId` and order them by `sortOrder`.

meritBadgeId.description: Merit badge `id` from the merit badge list (not `bsaNumber`)

tools.name: listRanks
tools.description: Returns ranks across all programs, one item per requirements version. A rank with several versions appears once per version, sharing `id` but with different `versionId`. Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing returns an empty list.

id.description: Return only versions of the rank with this `id`

programId.description: Return only ranks in this program

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year

status.description: `active` returns the current requirements version of each rank (some ranks have two current versions). `inactive` returns all other versions. Case-sensitive.

tools.name: getRank
tools.description: Returns every requirements version of one rank, active and inactive, as the same items the rank list returns. Query parameters are ignored. An ID that isn't in the rank list returns `400`, not `404`.

tools.name: getRankRequirements
tools.description: Returns one requirements version of a rank: the newest by default, or the one given by `versionId`. Requirements are a flat list; nest them using `parentRequirementId`. Some old versions have no requirements.

versionId.description: A `versionId` of this rank from the rank list. Defaults to the newest version.

tools.name: listSeaScoutElectives
tools.description: Returns Sea Scout electives, each with its requirements versions. Pass an elective's `ssElectiveId` to the requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Query parameters are ignored.

tools.name: getSeaScoutElectiveRequirements
tools.description: Returns one requirements version of a Sea Scout elective: the newest by default, or the one given by `ssVersionId`. Requirements are a flat list in no particular order; nest them using `parentRequirementId` and order them by `sortOrder`.

ssElectiveId.description: `ssElectiveId` from the Sea Scout elective list

ssVersionId.description: An `ssVersionId` of this elective from its `versions`. Defaults to the newest version.

tools.name: listAdventuresV2
tools.description: Returns Cub Scout adventures, one item per adventure, each with its requirements versions in `versions`. Pass an adventure's `id` and a `versionId` to the adventure requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Filters combine with AND. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

status.description: `active` (the default) leaves out retired adventures, those with an `expiryDt`, and `all` includes them. Case-sensitive.

id.description: Return only the adventure with this `id`

rankId.description: Return only adventures for this rank

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year. Adventures with no matching version stay in the list, with an empty `versions`.

versionId.description: Return only the adventure with this requirements version, with only that version in `versions`

required.description: `true` returns only required adventures, and `false` only elective ones

tools.name: getAdventureV2
tools.description: Returns one adventure with all its requirements versions. Retired adventures work too. Fields match the v2 adventure list's, without `expiryDt` and the versions' `isRequired`. Query parameters are ignored.

tools.name: listMeritBadgesV2
tools.description: Returns merit badges. Pass a badge's `id` to the merit badge requirements endpoint to get its requirements. Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing returns an empty list. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

id.description: Return only the merit badge with this `id`

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year. Badges with no matching version are left out.

status.description: Which requirements versions to put in `versions`. `active` (the default) gives each badge's current version and leaves out discontinued badges. `inactive` gives past versions, including those of discontinued badges, and leaves out badges with none. `all` gives both. Case-sensitive.

tools.name: getMeritBadgeV2
tools.description: Returns one merit badge with every requirements version, current and past, as the v2 merit badge list returns it with `status=all`. Discontinued badges work too. An ID that isn't a merit badge returns `400`, not `404`. Query parameters are ignored.

meritBadgeId.description: Merit badge `id` from the merit badge list (not `bsaNumber`)

tools.name: listRanksV2
tools.description: Returns ranks across all programs as an array, one item per rank, each with its requirements versions in `versions`. Filters combine with AND. A filter value that matches nothing returns an empty list. Unknown query parameters return `400`. Venturing Quest (`23`) is left out.

id.description: Return only the rank with this `id`

programId.description: Return only ranks in this program

version.description: Return only requirements versions from this year. Ranks with no matching version are left out.

status.description: `active` returns the same as no filter, and `inactive` returns an empty list. Case-sensitive.

tools.name: getRankV2
tools.description: Returns one rank with all its requirements versions. Fields match the v2 rank list's, except that most values the list gives as empty strings are `null` here. Venturing Quest (`23`), which isn't in the rank list, returns a record with almost every field empty. Query parameters are ignored.

tools.name: getRankRequirementsV2
tools.description: Returns one requirements version of a rank: the newest by default, or the one given by `versionId`. Requirements are a flat list; nest them using `parentRequirementId`. Some old versions have no requirements. Unlike the other v2 rank endpoints, most values are strings, and booleans are `"True"` / `"False"`.

versionId.description: A `versionId` of this rank from its `versions`. Defaults to the newest version.

tools.name: getSeaScoutElectiveV2
tools.description: Returns one Sea Scout elective with its requirements versions. Fields match the Sea Scout elective list's, except that some empty values are `null` and a version's `expireDate` has milliseconds and a `Z`. Query parameters are ignored.

ssElectiveId.description: `ssElectiveId` from the Sea Scout elective list

tools.name: listAddressTypes
tools.description: Returns all address types, such as home and mailing, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listCountries
tools.description: Returns all countries as an array sorted by `short`. With `id`, returns that one country as an object instead of an array.

id.description: Return only the country with this `id`, as a single object rather than an array

tools.name: listStates
tools.description: Returns all US states, DC, territories, and military (APO) codes as an array sorted by `short`. With `id`, returns that one state as an object instead of an array.

id.description: Return only the state with this `id`, as a single object rather than an array

tools.name: listActivityCategories
tools.description: Returns all activity categories, including expired ones, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listActivityTypes
tools.description: Returns all activity types as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listCalendarEventTypes
tools.description: Returns all calendar event types, including expired ones, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listMeritBadgeCategories
tools.description: Returns all merit badge categories as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listPositions
tools.description: Returns all positions, including retired ones, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listRankSummaries
tools.description: Returns one short entry per rank, across all programs, as an array sorted by `id`. Unlike the rank list, each rank appears once rather than once per requirements version.

tools.name: listSwimmingClassifications
tools.description: Returns all swimming classifications as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listUnitTimezones
tools.description: Returns the time zones a unit can be set to, as an array.

tools.name: listUnitTypes
tools.description: Returns all unit types as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listYouthLeadershipPositions
tools.description: Returns youth leadership positions as an array sorted by `id`. These are a subset of the positions list, sharing its `id` values, but with native JSON types: numbers and booleans instead of strings, and `null` where the positions list has an empty string.

unitTypeId.description: Return only positions for this unit type, with each position's `unitTypes` narrowed to that one entry. Must be a unit type `id` from the unit type list; one with no positions returns an empty list. Some positions that list the unit type are still left out, so results can differ from filtering the full list.

tools.name: listCommunicationClassifications
tools.description: Returns the groups communication types fall into, such as phone and email, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listCommunicationTypes
tools.description: Returns the kinds of contact entry a person can have, such as a home email or mobile phone, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listMobilePhoneCarriers
tools.description: Returns all mobile phone carriers as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listPhoneCountryCodes
tools.description: Returns all country calling codes for phone numbers as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listSocialMediaTypes
tools.description: Returns the social media platforms a profile can link to, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listOrganizationPositions
tools.description: Returns the person positions that have not expired, as an array sorted by `positionId`, with fields renamed and IDs as numbers. Fields match the person position list, except that `isKey3` and `isPlus3` can be `null` where that list has `false`.

organizationType.description: Organization type `id` from the organization type list, as a number. Returns only positions whose `relationshipTypeId` matches. For `6` (Unit), only some of those positions are returned. `7` returns an empty list, and `8` is rejected.

tools.name: listOrganizationTypes
tools.description: Returns all organization types as an array sorted by `name`.

tools.name: listOrganizationUnitTypes
tools.description: Returns all organization unit types as an array sorted by `id`. IDs `1` to `6` match the unit type list, but the rest differ: here `7` is Group and `10` is Lab, while in the unit type list `7` is Club and `8` is Lab.

tools.name: listEmployers
tools.description: Returns all employers as an array sorted by `id`, with no filters or paging.

tools.name: listEthnicities
tools.description: Returns all ethnicities as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listGenders
tools.description: Returns all genders as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listGrades
tools.description: Returns all school grades as an array sorted by `id`. Sort by `displayOrder` to get grade order, since Kindergarten has `id` 14.

tools.name: listMaritalStatuses
tools.description: Returns all marital statuses as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listNameSuffixes
tools.description: Returns all personal name suffixes as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listOccupations
tools.description: Returns all occupations as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listOccupationTypes
tools.description: Returns all occupation types, the groups occupations fall into, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listPersonPositions
tools.description: Returns all person positions, including expired ones, as an array sorted by `id`. These IDs are separate from the positions list's; that list and the youth leadership positions list link here through `akelaPositionId`, and the organization position list through `positionId`.

tools.name: listRelationshipTypes
tools.description: Returns all relationship types between two people, such as family and guardian relationships, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listReligions
tools.description: Returns all religions as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listSchools
tools.description: Returns schools whose name matches `name`, as an array sorted by `name`. Filters combine with AND, and a search that matches nothing returns an empty list. At most 100,000 schools are returned.

name.description: Case-insensitive search for schools whose `name` contains this text. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored, but counts toward the length limits. `%` matches any run of characters and `_` any single character, so `%%` matches every school.

state.description: Return only schools whose `stateCode` is exactly this value, ignoring case and trailing spaces

city.description: Return only schools whose `city` contains this text, ignoring case. `%` and `_` are wildcards, as in `name`.

zip.description: Return only schools whose `zip` is exactly this value. Matches the stored value, so a ZIP code stored without its leading zero must be given without it.

tools.name: listTitlePrefixes
tools.description: Returns all personal title prefixes as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listPaymentTypes
tools.description: Returns all ways a registration can be paid, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listRenewalOptoutReasons
tools.description: Returns all reasons a member can give for not renewing their registration, as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listRegistrationStatuses
tools.description: Returns all registration statuses as an array sorted by `id`.

tools.name: listTrainingCourses
tools.description: Returns training courses as an array sorted by `programId`, then by `courseDescription` ignoring case. A course offered in several programs appears once per program. Unknown query parameters are ignored.

programId.description: Return only courses in this program. A program with no courses returns an empty list.

tools.name: getOrganizationProfile
tools.description: Returns a unit, district, council, or service territory. Units have a `program` and a `charter`, and most unit-only fields are `null` or empty on other organizations. Without a valid token, `key3` and `executiveOfficer` are masked as `***`. An invalid token is treated as none. Query parameters are ignored.

organizationGuid.description: A version 4 GUID identifying an organization

tools.name: listCouncils
tools.description: Returns the council that serves a ZIP code, as a list of at most one. A ZIP code no council serves returns an empty list. Some codes that aren't US ZIP codes still return a council.

tools.name: getOrganization
tools.description: Returns a unit, Exploring post, or council. The ID is matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: searchOrganizations
tools.description: Returns every organization in the ZIP code, whatever its distance, followed by organizations from other ZIP codes within `radius`. Each part is ordered by `mileage`. A ZIP code with no organizations returns an empty list. Results are summaries, and their values can disagree with the organization's full record.

radius.description: Search radius in miles. Fractions are allowed.

CUB_SCOUTS.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

SCOUTS_BSA.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

VENTURING.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

SEA_SCOUTS.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

EXPLORING.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

NA.description: `ALL` matches every `gender`. Other values match that `gender` exactly, except `NA`, which matches nothing. Use `ALL` for programs whose units are all `NA`, such as Venturing.

programAcceptGender.description: Return only the programs listed, each filtered by `gender`. Omit it, or send an empty object, for every program.

tools.name: getZipCodeCoordinates
tools.description: Returns the latitude and longitude of a ZIP code. Lookups aren't limited to US ZIP codes: a 5-digit code that isn't one may return the location of a postal code in another country.
